claims: The United States Special Operations Command (USSOCOM or SOCOM) is headquartered at MacDill AFB in Tampa, FL.
The United States Special Operations Command is the unified combatant command charged with overseeing special operations forces from the Army, Air Force, Navy, and Marine Corps.
The United States Special Operations Command was founded on April 16, 1987.

The United States Special Operations Command's mission is to train, develop, and deploy fully capable Special Operations Forces (SOF) to conduct global, unconventional warfare, counter-terrorism, and special reconnaissance missions.
The United States Special Operations Command's headquarters is at 7701 Tampa Point Blvd, MacDill AFB, FL.
The United States Special Operations Command's Public Affairs phone number is (813) 826-8800.
The United States Special Operations Command was created following the 1980 Operation Eagle Claw failure to address lack of inter-service coordination.
The United States Special Operations Command was officially activated in 1987.
SOCOM oversees components from all service branches.
Army Special Operations Command includes Special Forces (Green Berets) and Rangers.
Naval Special Warfare Command includes SEALs and Special Warfare Combatant-craft Crewmen.
Air Force Special Operations Command includes Special Tactics and Air Commando forces.
Marine Corps Forces Special Operations Command includes Marine Raiders.
